description.narrative:
Ipas' VISION: A world where every woman and girl has the right and ability to determine her own sexuality and reproductive health
Ipas' MISSION: Women and girls have improved sexual and reproductive health and rights through enhanced access to and use of safe abortion and contraceptive care The Ultimate Outcome is to create sustainable abortion ecosystems, defined as a dynamic condition in which resilient local stakeholders and systems are actively accountable and committed to abortion rights and responsive to everyone's abortion needs.
The three immediate outcomes: 1. Increased Political Support and Leadership: Efforts that support legal and policy advocacy that improves gender-responsive policies, legislation, and financial commitments to safe abortion care. 2. Improved Knowledge and Support: Efforts that ensure that accurate information on abortion is available and accessible, people have access to medical abortion (MA) drugs with or without a prescription, abortion decisions are based on need and preference, and pathways to abortion are clear and accessible. 3. Strengthened Pathways: Efforts that ensure that pathways to abortion are clear and accessible and that access to abortion is readily available and integrated throughout the health care system, with services free of stigma, respectful of human rights, and available through a trained and supported health workforce that meets service delivery standards.
One crosscutting outome: 1. Reduced abortion stigma: Because stigma is a major barrier to improving abortion access, Ipas includes stigma reduction as a cross-cutting outcome.

Ipas är en internationell civilsamhällesorganisation som har arbetat i mer än 50 år för att förbättra kvinnors och flickors sexuella och reproduktiva hälsa och rättigheter (SRHR) genom att förbättra deras tillgång till och användning av säker abort- och preventivmedelsvård. Ipas är en unikt viktig och ansedd aktör med stark genomslagskraft och omfattande verksamhet på global nivå och i stort antal låginkomstländer. En central utgångspunkt för Ipas verksamhet är att tillgång till säker, laglig abort är avgörande för kvinnors och flickors hälsa och välbefinnande, och är en grundläggande mänsklig rättighet vilket gör deras verksamhet fullt relevant också för jämställdhet. Ipas bedöms ha god förståelse för de miljöutmaningar världen står inför och har de senaste åren anpassat sin verksamhet för klimatförändringar.

Renewed support to Ipas which is an international, nongovernmental organisation that has worked for more than 50 years to improve the sexual and reproductive health and rights (SRHR) of women and girls by enhancing their access to and use of comprehensive safe abortion and contraception care. Ipas' combined efforts in service provision, methods development (e.g. for medical abortion/self managed abortion), capacity building and evidence ­based policy work cannot be replaced in the global and national ecosystems of actors who work for SRHR and the right to safe abortion. They have proven to have strong impact and large scope globally and nationally. A central starting point for Ipas is that access to safe, legal abortion is critical for women’s and girls’ health, well­being, and is a fundamental human right which make their relevance for gener equality strong. Ipas is assessed to have a very good understanding of the environmental challenges the world is facing and have developed a strong environmental and climate impact analysis to identify opportunities for a positive impact from the contribution on the environment.
